notes: Everything is in rounds/results.py: checked_target (used for GET and again under the round lock for POST) refuses Closed rounds, superseded builds and, on POST, submitted results, and reads only the signed-in tester's result; show() makes a submitted result read-only; ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation and RoundTextField(max_length=2000) limits it. M1 drops the tester filter, so another tester's result is shown and overwritten; M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place, as it is navigation, not a guard. M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005 to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
